description: Ends a mock interview and returns the scorecard: each competency met, partly or not shown (from the structure checks), and the three questions to practise next with their ids. Saves the progress of each checked answer (question id, checks met, word count) to the practice of the account, deleted after 180 days; the answer texts only with keep_answer_text true, encrypted with the account key (for an answer not in English, its English translation); nothing with save_progress false. The answers are then removed from the session; finishing again returns the same scorecard. Requires sign-in with a PM Career Desk account that has an Interview Coach Pass.

keep_answer_text.description: True only when the person asked to keep the text of the answer; it is kept encrypted with the account key.
keep_answer_text.title: Keep Answer Text

save_progress.description: False saves nothing to the practice of the account.
save_progress.title: Save Progress
